editorial:
Imagine your life being flipped upside down by one horrible night. That is exactly what happens to Rose, who is attacked by a drunk cab driver. Instead of letting the trauma break her, she decides to fight back in a huge way. She hides away from the world and builds a secret life as the Mad Rose, a scary vigilante who hunts down other rapists and criminals in Taipei. You can really feel her anger as she tracks her targets, and it is honestly satisfying to see her take control of her life by becoming the predator instead of the prey.

What makes this one stand out is how the tension builds as the police start closing in on her. The action is raw and the pacing keeps you on your toes. While some of the 80s effects look a bit dated, the raw emotion in the acting carries the story. If you love gritty revenge stories, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a high-stakes game of cat and mouse between Rose and the police. After a series of violent clashes, the cops finally corner her in a final showdown. Rose refuses to give up or go quietly, leading to a bloody confrontation. She manages to get her final revenge, but the law eventually catches up to her. It wraps up as a tragedy, showing that while she found peace through revenge, it cost her everything.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty 80s revenge flicks and vigilante justice stories.
